verdict.rationale: Bento hosts its own MCP server so an AI assistant can look up subscribers, create broadcasts and track events "through natural conversation." Its homepage also advertises a native plain-text builder where users describe what they want and Bento's AI builds it. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation, and the scope of the native plain-text AI builder (what it can build) is undocumented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Bento MCP server gives your AI assistant direct access to your Bento account. It can look up subscribers, create broadcasts, track events, and more, all through natural conversation.
Describe what you want in plain text and let Bento's powerful AI build it for you.
Bento hosts the MCP server at `https://mcp.bentonow.com/mcp`. You point your AI app at that URL and add your API keys.
